The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “因为孟子现在没有朋友，他老是读书。” Formula: Subject + 一直 + VP (for a neutral or positive repeated action) Correct: “因为孟子现在没有朋友，他一直读书。” “老是” usually expresses annoyance or a complaint.

items.reason: The problem is the causal relationship: Mengzi has no friends because he always studies, not that he studies because he has no friends; changing 老是 to 一直 does not fix this.
